documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: In Q1 FY27, Krishana Phoschem Limited reported revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, representing a 35% year-on-year growth despite global supply-side disruptions and raw material cost inflation. EBITDA increased 36% year-on-year to ₹89 crore, while PAT rose 54% to ₹47 crore. Management expects to achieve a quarterly revenue run-rate of more than ₹500 crore in the remaining quarters of FY27, supported by ramped-up capacity utilization following the addition of 165,000 MT to its NPK-DAP capacity. The company also executed a 5-for-1 stock split during the period to enhance share liquidity. Krishana Phoschem reported a 34.58% year-on-year revenue growth for Q1 FY27, supported by expanded capacities in NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over the previous year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: Krishana Phoschem expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The newly commissioned NPK capacity is expected to witness a steady ramp-up in utilization over coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The NPK capacity commission during the previous quarter is expected to witness a steady ramp-up in utilization over the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line growth of around Rs. 500 crore from the expanded capacity, taking total revenue to Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Overall revenue growth for FY27 is projected at 35% to 40%.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Cumulative rainfall by the end of June was nearly 40% below normal, causing national Kharif sowing to fall by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares.
demand_outlook.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher crop MSPs, and government NBS framework support are expected to support fertilizer demand for the rest of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif 2026 season demand environment is viewed as constructive due to comfortable domestic stock levels and favorable monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The government's fertilizer subsidy outlay exceeding ₹2.4 lakh crore for FY27 is expected to support farmer affordability and sector stability.
demand_outlook.quote: The Cabinet's approval of NBS rates for Kharif 2026, alongside a fertilizer subsidy outlay exceeding ₹2.4 lakh crore for FY27, underscores the government's commitment to farmer affordability & sector stability.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure as any softening would first be absorbed by imports.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure. Even hypothetically, if demand were to soften, it is important to note that nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, expanding its total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved or publicly disclosed.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has commissioned NPK/DAP capacity of 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA at Meghnagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and total phosphatic fertilizer capacity reached 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached ₹89 crore, registering 36% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of increased input costs through higher subsidies and revised prices.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Lower-cost inventory carried forward from the previous quarter contributed to higher quarterly EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Finance costs increased to around ₹20 crore and depreciation increased to ₹13 crore due to newly commissioned capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Global market input prices witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, gas-linked production tightness, and higher logistic and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the quarter, creating a timing mismatch with slowing domestic demand in March.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to come down slightly during FY27 as input cost increases are partially absorbed.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27. But a major part will have to be borne by the consumers.

orders_capacity.claim: Krishana Phoschem achieved 43% capacity utilization in its NPK-DAP unit during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total quarterly fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for the quarter were 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production for the quarter reached 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, reducing the face value of equity shares from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Krishana Phoschem collected more than ₹700 crore in receivables during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry-wide fertilizer production dropped by 28% year-on-year during April-May 2026 due to raw material and logistics constraints.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the April-May 2026 period, industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year, while SSP production dropped by around 7% year-on-year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues in West Asia and shipping uncertainty in the Strait of Hormuz led to increased freight costs and delayed vessel movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices increased from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorables.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies heavily on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: Krishana Phoschem expects to achieve a quarterly turnover exceeding ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The 70,000 MTPA third-party green ammonia capacity arrangement signed with SECI will start operations in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the benefits of the capacity expansion to meaningfully reflect in its performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to the best utilization of its manufacturing facilities.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to the best utilization of our manufacturing facilities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
